description: TC-07.5: Work Order Failure Reporting — Navigate to failure analysis and view failure records

doc_metadata.title: TC-07.5 — Failure Analysis List
doc_metadata.caption: Navigate to Failure Analysis. Failure analysis records document root causes, remedies, and risk priority numbers (RPN) for equipment failures.

doc_metadata.title: TC-07.5 — Failure Analysis List View
doc_metadata.caption: The Failure Analysis list shows all failure records with failure modes, cause codes, severity ratings, and RPN scores. Filter by asset or date range.

doc_metadata.title: TC-07.5 — Open Failure Analysis
doc_metadata.caption: Click on a failure analysis record to view its details including failure mode, cause, severity, occurrence, and detection ratings.

doc_metadata.title: TC-07.5 — Wait for Page Load
doc_metadata.caption: Wait for all page components to finish loading and rendering.

doc_metadata.title: TC-07.5 — Failure Analysis Detail
doc_metadata.caption: The failure analysis detail shows failure mode, cause code, remedy code, severity/occurrence/detection ratings, and RPN score. Server actions enable 5-Why and Fishbone templates.
